title: Optimizer candidate and promotion safety
description:
Purpose: Ensure optimizer candidates are mechanically valid, compared against the correct incumbent, and supported by sufficient evidence before promotion can be recommended.

Exclusions:
- Client-specific rubric judgments.
- Automatic production promotion without the established approval gate.
- Replacing the canonical evaluator.

Dependencies: Uses frozen cohort and provenance contracts from the reproducible-cohorts epic. Most mechanical validation can proceed independently.

Definition of Done:
- Class collapse, invalid output classes, broken inter-node dataflow, unsafe dry-run writes, and unintended model changes fail closed.
- Candidate and synthesis selection compare against the current leader on identical cohorts.
- Promotion evidence includes validation outcomes, cohort identity, metrics, and explicit unresolved risks.
- Behavior-first specifications and focused tests pass.

Running log: Record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, and next steps in this epic or its child issues.
